items.title_zh: [MOABB] 修复下载中“~”前缀URL组件并迁移现有“~bci”幽灵条目（#1181）
items.title_en: [MOABB] Fix download sanitization for '~'-prefixed URLs and migrate '~bci' ghosts (#1181)
bullets_zh: 2026年9月19日，NeuroTechX/moabb合并提交#1181，清理“~”前缀URL组件并迁移现有“~bci”幽灵条目。
该修复提升MOABB中EEG-BCI基准数据集检索的可靠性。
bullets_en: On 2026-09-19, NeuroTechX/moabb merged commit #1181 to sanitize '~'-prefixed URL components and migrate existing '~bci' ghost entries.
The fix improves reliable retrieval of EEG-BCI benchmark datasets in MOABB.
items.brief: MOABB提交修复下载URL处理，提升EEG基准数据获取可靠性。
items.brief_en: MOABB commit fixes download URL handling to improve EEG-BCI benchmark dataset retrieval reliability.
items.raw_excerpt: fix(download): sanitize '~'-prefixed URL components and migrate existing '~bci' ghosts (#1181)

items.title_zh: [MOABB] 修复moabb.run的-e参数将值拆分为字符的问题（#1179）
items.title_en: [MOABB] Fix the -e flag of moabb.run splitting its value into characters (#1179)
bullets_zh: 2026年9月18日，提交#1179修复moabb.run的-e参数，使其值不再被拆分为字符。
这避免了运行MOABB基准流程时出现命令行评测失败。
bullets_en: On 2026-09-18, commit #1179 fixes the -e flag of moabb.run so its value is no longer split into characters.
This prevents command-line evaluation failures when running MOABB benchmark pipelines.
items.brief: MOABB提交修复moabb.run的-e参数解析，避免命令行评测失败。
items.brief_en: MOABB commit fixes moabb.run -e flag parsing to prevent command-line evaluation failures.
items.raw_excerpt: Fix the -e flag of moabb.run splitting its value into characters (#1179)

items.title_en: [MOABB] Fix pyRiemann mean API compatibility in TRCA and TRCSP (#1180)
bullets_zh: 2026年9月14日，提交#1180更新TRCA和TRCSP以匹配当前pyRiemann均值API。
该兼容性修复使黎曼EEG-BCI算法在MOABB中可继续运行。
bullets_en: On 2026-09-14, commit #1180 updates TRCA and TRCSP to match the current pyRiemann mean API.
The compatibility fix keeps Riemannian EEG-BCI algorithms runnable in MOABB.
items.brief_en: MOABB commit updates TRCA/TRCSP for pyRiemann mean API compatibility in Riemannian BCI pipelines.
items.raw_excerpt: Fix pyRiemann mean API compatibility in TRCA and TRCSP (#1180)

bullets_en: On 2026-09-08, docs commit #1174 updates the RPA example to use TLCenter.
It clarifies recommended centering usage for MOABB benchmark examples.

bullets_zh: 2026年9月5日，提交#1175修复extra_runs行为，并重构RomaniBF2025ERP的带末端缓冲区段提取。
它更新示例和裁剪处理以适配校准缓冲，提升MOABB中ERP数据集使用体验。
bullets_en: On 2026-09-05, commit #1175 fixes extra_runs behavior and refactors RomaniBF2025ERP epoch extraction with an end buffer.
It updates examples and crop handling for calibration buffers, improving ERP dataset use in MOABB.
